_note: Arms ~5% longer, nothing else changed. UpperArm.L/.R scaled bone-local Y (the head->tail length axis) by 1.05; LowerArm.L/.R are left to inherit (inherit_scale FULL) so the forearm both follows the elongated upper arm and stretches the same 5% -> uniform shoulder-to-wrist +5%. Hand.L/.R set inherit_scale NONE so the hands ride out to the new wrist at their original size (arms longer, hands unchanged). The T-pose arm is straight (UpperArm/LowerArm colinear along +X in armature space), so the inherited stretch stays axis-clean. Mirrors the proven leg-lengthening idiom in custom_shinano.json (root bone scaled along length, mid bone inherits, terminal bone no-inherit). No shapekeys (arm length needs no anti-clip morph). No object transform and no height change, so ViewPosition is unaffected.
